worldcombat.skill.fissure.summary: Lock a spot on the real ground under the foe from afar and let a seam run along the connected surface to open there: the closest one still standing on that patch takes a heavy blow. The seam only travels over connected, really supported ground, so cliffs and walls stop it; only a short-lived crack remains.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.description.0: The seam reaches %1$s blocks over real ground and opens a %2$s-block gap at the landing point. The closest target still touching that ground takes a fixed %3$s damage. It is no longer an instant kill; native immunity and damage rules still apply.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.description.1: There are %1$s s between locking the spot and the pit opening; every level above the target shortens it, and the target must step off or jump away in that time.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.description.2: A short-lived crack is left along the landing point and the path for %1$s s; it is only visual, replacing no blocks, sealing nothing, and dealing no damage.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.deep.on: Deep form: a larger pit and a longer-lived crack, but the opening is delayed by 8 ticks - a wider trap the target is also more likely to escape.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.deep.off: Quick form: opens sooner and recharges faster, but a smaller pit and a shorter crack.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s from the strike.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.growth.0: From level %1$s the pit radius rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.growth.1: From level %1$s the pit radius rises to %2$s blocks, the range to %3$s blocks and the crack lingers %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.use.0: Delete a high-value grounded target from a distance
worldcombat.skill.fissure.use.1: Force a foe off its footing or into the air
worldcombat.skill.fissure.use.2: Leave a short-lived crack on the ground
worldcombat.skill.fissure.preference.dee: On: pit x1.25 and a longer-lived crack (x1.35), but the opening is delayed by 8 ticks - a wider trap the target can escape more easily, for forcing movement. Off (quick form): opens sooner and recharges faster, but a smaller pit and a shorter crack, for finishing a target before it can leave.
The companion only considers fissure while the threat is within this distance; smaller keeps it to close range, larger opens from further away.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.description.gr: It can only be cast on a grounded enemy, and the user must be standing on the ground too; the ground under both must be connected. Airborne targets, cliffs and walls cannot be caught.
